CustomField.description: Financial system sync stopped after repeated hard (data) failures (Svc_FinancialSystemSyncAlert.HARD_FAILURE_LIMIT); the batch skips it until the data is corrected and the sync is restarted. Technical failures never block.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The Exact sync stopped because the same data problem failed several times (see Financial Sync Last Error). Correct it and use "Sync to Exact (new)".
CustomField.label: Exact Sync Blocked
